recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the seed issue's remaining current-source gap without changing the Signature model or MIME binding; further work is only needed if the Security WG wants additional non-cryptographic signature examples.
issue_request: FHIR-7702 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Security WG request to add a MIME/content-type indicator to Signature, document XML DigSig and JWT use, mention image/* and application/pdf for other signature reproductions, add XML and JWT examples, and update Signature documentation beyond XML DigSig only.
initial_application: Git commit 3d8acf3aa0ccb15662c358df4bab917916002a4d (#7702/SVN r5819) broadened Signature from XML-only to XML DigSig, JWT, and graphical signature forms and added Signature.contentType. Later history renamed Signature.blob to Signature.data, split contentType into targetFormat and sigFormat for FHIR-14175, and added current JWS examples on the active signatures page.
additional_context: Signature is active and normative in source/fhir.ini, with source/datatypes/signature.xml as the authoritative spreadsheet source for the datatype. Current source already has Signature.sigFormat bound to MimeType, XML DigSig and JWS guidance, an XML Signature datatype example, and JWS examples. Later reconciliations for FHIR-14175, FHIR-47211, and FHIR-48679 preserve the targetFormat/sigFormat split and valid MIME-type scoping without superseding FHIR-7702's application/pdf instruction.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/signature.xml so Signature.sigFormat lists application/pdf alongside image/* as an important MIME type for non-cryptographic signature representations, and corrected the adjacent XML DigSig spacing typo in the same sentence.
source_changes: source/datatypes/signature.xml: Added application/pdf to the Signature.sigFormat important MIME type examples and corrected the adjacent XML DigSig spacing typo.
